messages:
maya: Quick question: if we move external REST -> gateway -> single internal gRPC surface (proto), how do we keep per-route quotas and Console telemetry? :thinking:

rahul: We can't lose per-route metrics. Idea: gateway attaches route metadata into gRPC metadata (x-rd-route) and internal services read it for telemetry + quota checks.

jess: That's doable but adds coupling. We often use a single 'Dispatch' RPC that multiplexes endpoints, so path info is required. How do we handle auth/token scopes? Gateway should validate tokens and forward claims.

leah: Console needs token-level cost/latency breakdown. If gateway opaque-fies requests, Console can't attribute tokens to models. Gateway must emit enriched spans with route and model info.

infra-bot: Envoy config example:
```
- add_request_headers:
    - name: x-rd-route
      value: "%REQ(:PATH)%"
# map header -> gRPC metadata via lua/grpc_transcoder
```

rahul: Envoy can map header to gRPC metadata via a lua filter or grpc_json_transcoder. But extra filters add CPU. Alternative: keep REST for public endpoints and gRPC for internal service-to-service.

maya: Tradeoffs: REST public + internal gRPC keeps typed contracts and reduces surface. But we lose direct per-route rate-limit configs unless gateway expands per-route rules.

jess: We could have gateway maintain a per-path quota table and use token claims + x-rd-route to compute quota. For telemetry, add 'route' attribute to OpenTelemetry spans and logs.

leah: UX ask: Console should show model-level ops even when requests hit a shared Dispatch RPC. Require standard metadata keys: x-rd-model and x-rd-route.

rahul: :thumbsup: I'll prototype an Envoy lua that sets metadata from path + injects x-rd-model when gateway resolves a model. Will send a PR.

maya: Thanks. One more: how do we surface failures when gateway retries across model variants? We need rollout/fallback events in Console. Gateway could emit an event or set x-rd-fallback header on fallback.

ops-bot: note: quota enforcement is currently implemented in gateway only. If we move checks downstream, org-wide rate limiting will be inconsistent. ops-ticket #3421 opened.

jess: Agreed. Keep enforcement in gateway, but pass metadata for downstream observability and optional secondary checks. Suggest RFC: add optional map<string,string> gateway_metadata to DispatchRequest proto.

maya: RFC + prototype. I'll put it on Friday's sync. Thanks all :+1:
